muc_tieu: Model re ra soat 7 module loi cua The Brain tim loi im lang; Claude phan loai ket qua, chi sua cai that
boi_canh: Du an The Brain: lab kiem thu chien luoc forex/CFD bang du lieu va tester. Sai so lieu im lang la loi nang nhat.

Ra soat mot module Python cua he kiem thu chien luoc giao dich (The Brain). Muc tieu: tim LOI THAT hoac RUI RO SAI SO LIEU, khong phai gop y van phong.
Chi quan tam: (1) loi logic / sai dau / chia cho 0 / bien gioi / lam tron; (2) cho co the cho ra con so SAI ma khong bao loi (im lang); (3) logic bi lap hoac mau thuan voi docstring cua chinh no; (4) thieu kiem tra dau vao quan trong. KHONG de xuat viet lai ca module, khong gop y dat ten.
Bat buoc: moi phat hien phai tro DUNG ten ham / lop co that trong tep (hoac '(toan_tep)'), noi CU THE dong logic nao sai va sai ra sao, kem de xuat sua ngan.
Tra DUNG mot JSON {"phat_hien":[{"ham":"...","muc_do":"CAO|TB|THAP","van_de":"...","de_xuat":"..."}]} voi 2 den 8 muc, xep CAO truoc. Neu thay it hon 2 van de that thi neu cac rui ro nho nhat. Khong bia.
